topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the notebook tucked between the old, dusty tomes on the highest shelf, where the shadows play tricks on the eyes. Each page, filled with words that danced around a character unmistakably familiar, yet altered by the whims of imagination. It’s as if I’ve been watching a play of my own life, scripted by someone who knows the lines better than I do. The plot twists, the unspoken thoughts, and the whispered secrets—all penned with such care. I can almost smell the ink and hear the scratching of the quill, a symphony of stories within stories. The room seems to have grown quieter, the air warmer, as I turn the last page, wondering where this tale will lead us next.
